title: PredActor: Predictive Action Diffusion for Steerable Onboard Humanoid Control
abstract: arXiv:2609.24840v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion models offer flexible motion generation, but translating this flexibility into feedback-responsive humanoid control remains challenging. Hierarchical systems steer motion through references that may exceed a separate tracker's capabilities, leaving recovery and physical execution largely to the tracker. Action-only diffusion generates actions directly but lacks an explicit future-state trajectory for test-time motion objectives. Joint state-action diffusion provides this representation, yet representative controllers often depend on privileged full-body states, and support for learned behavior selection and test-time motion steering remains fragmented. We present PredActor, a predictive action diffusion policy that brings these complementary steering capabilities into one directly executed policy using proprioceptive observations. translated_title: PredActor：面向可引导人形机器人本体控制的预测性动作扩散
translated_abstract: 扩散模型提供了灵活的运动生成能力，但如何将这种灵活性转化为具备反馈响应能力的人形机器人控制仍然具有挑战性。分层系统通过参考信号来引导运动，但这些参考信号可能超出独立跟踪器的执行能力，使得恢复和物理执行在很大程度上依赖于跟踪器。纯动作扩散模型直接生成动作，但缺乏用于测试时运动目标的显式未来状态轨迹。联合状态-动作扩散模型提供了这种表示，然而代表性的控制器通常依赖于特权全身状态，且对学习到的行为选择和测试时运动引导的支持仍然零散。我们提出了PredActor，一种预测性动作扩散策略，它利用本体感知观测将这些互补的引导能力整合到一个可直接执行的策略中。以本体感知历史和可选的任务上下文为条件，PredActor联合生成可执行的动作（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: PredActor提出了一种基于本体感知观测的预测性动作扩散策略，将学习到的行为选择与测试时运动引导能力整合到单一可直接执行的人形机器人控制策略中。
en_tdlr: PredActor is a predictive action diffusion policy that integrates learned behavior selection and test-time motion steering into a single directly executable humanoid control policy using only proprioceptive observations.
